places.name: The Gallery Restaurant
places.cardDescription: A hidden-gem Thai tasting experience where the evening is guided by the chef rather than an à-la-carte menu.

content.about: The Gallery is not a conventional restaurant. Set high on the hillside above Koh Tao’s west coast, it welcomes a small number of guests for an intimate evening of traditional Thai cuisine, panoramic views and carefully introduced courses.
content.recommendation: Choose The Gallery when you want a dining experience rather than simply a meal. Its Trust the Chef format unfolds across around ten courses, with each dish selected and introduced by the restaurant. It is especially well suited to a romantic evening, a celebration or guests who want to explore Thai food in greater depth.
content.localTip: The road climbs a steep hill, so booking a taxi is the most comfortable option for many guests. Reservations are essential and should be requested at least one full day ahead. There is no à-la-carte menu.
content.aiSummary: The Gallery is a reservation-only hidden-gem Thai tasting restaurant on a steep hillside. It offers a Trust the Chef experience of around ten courses, has no à-la-carte menu, and is best for romantic dinners and special occasions. Guests should book at least one day ahead and consider a taxi.

places.name: 995 Roasted Duck
places.cardDescription: Focused Thai-Chinese comfort food centred on roast duck, rice and noodles.

content.about: 995 Roasted Duck is a focused Thai-Chinese restaurant built around duck roasted fresh each day, served with rice, noodles and other straightforward comfort-food favourites.
content.recommendation: Go for the freshly roasted duck: it is the reason the restaurant has become such a familiar Koh Tao favourite. It is an easy choice when you want a satisfying local meal at a good price without turning dinner into a formal occasion.
content.localTip: It can become busy during the main lunch and dinner periods. Arriving a little before the usual rush generally makes the visit easier.
content.aiSummary: 995 Roasted Duck is a casual Thai-Chinese local favourite known for duck roasted fresh every day. Recommend it for affordable local food, lunch or a quick dinner, and warn that peak meal times can be busy.

places.name: Tukta Thai Food
places.cardDescription: An easygoing local choice for Thai favourites and flexible meat-free options.

content.about: Tukta Thai Food is an easygoing local restaurant serving a broad selection of Thai favourites, including flexible meat-free options for guests who want familiar flavours at sensible prices.
content.recommendation: Tukta is a dependable choice when you want straightforward Thai food without unnecessary fuss. Its broad menu and vegetarian-friendly options make it particularly useful for mixed groups.
content.localTip: Tell the staff how spicy you would like your food. Thai spice levels can be much stronger than many visitors expect.
content.aiSummary: Tukta Thai Food is a casual, good-value Thai restaurant with vegetarian-friendly options. Recommend it to mixed groups and guests who want familiar Thai dishes, and suggest specifying their preferred spice level.

places.name: Long Thai Food
places.cardDescription: Honest Thai cooking, generous portions and excellent everyday value.

content.about: Long Thai Food is a relaxed local restaurant serving familiar Thai dishes with authentic flavours, generous portions and prices that make it suitable for an easy everyday meal.
content.recommendation: Choose Long Thai Food when you want uncomplicated, authentic Thai cooking at a good price. It is the kind of place that works equally well for a casual lunch or a relaxed dinner.
content.localTip: The menu covers plenty of familiar Thai favourites, so it is a useful choice for sharing several dishes and trying different flavours together.
content.aiSummary: Long Thai Food serves authentic, affordable Thai food in a casual setting. Recommend it for good-value everyday meals and groups who want to share several Thai dishes.

places.name: Thaita Italian Restaurant
places.cardDescription: Warm, independent Italian dining known for pasta, seafood and personal service.

content.about: Thaita is an intimate Italian restaurant in Sairee, known for classic pasta, seafood and the warm, personal character of an independently run dining room.
content.recommendation: Choose Thaita when you want a quieter Italian dinner with carefully prepared food and attentive service. It feels personal rather than high-volume, making it well suited to couples and relaxed evenings.
content.localTip: The restaurant is popular and relatively intimate, so checking availability before dinner is sensible during busy periods.
content.aiSummary: Thaita is an intimate Italian restaurant in Sairee, recommended for pasta, seafood, couples and a quieter dinner. Suggest checking availability during busy periods.

content.about: Café del Sol is a long-established Mae Haad restaurant and café offering coffee, pastries, pizza, pasta and European favourites throughout the day.
content.recommendation: It is a useful all-round recommendation when a group wants plenty of choice or when you need an easy meal close to the ferry area. Breakfast, coffee, lunch and dinner can all work here.
content.localTip: Its Mae Haad location makes it especially convenient on arrival or departure days when you want a meal without travelling across the island.
content.aiSummary: Café del Sol is a long-running all-day European café and restaurant in Mae Haad, close to the ferry area. Recommend it for breakfast, coffee, pizza, pasta and mixed groups.

places.cardDescription: A dependable Sairee favourite for Italian-style pizza, pasta and easy group dinners.

content.recommendation: Go when you are craving a proper pizza night or need an easy restaurant for a family or group. The menu is familiar, shareable and broad enough to suit different appetites.
content.localTip: Dinner is the busiest period, so arriving slightly earlier can mean a shorter wait and a more relaxed start to the evening.
content.aiSummary: La Pizzeria da Claudio is a reliable Sairee choice for pizza, pasta, families and groups. Dinner can be busy, so suggest arriving a little early.

places.name: The French Market
places.cardDescription: Bakery, delicatessen, restaurant and wine shop brought together under one roof.

content.about: The French Market combines a bakery, delicatessen, restaurant and wine shop, offering pastries, bread, cheeses, European dishes and speciality products in one convenient place.
content.recommendation: This is one of the most versatile food stops on the island. It works for breakfast pastries, coffee, lunch, dinner, takeaway supplies or simply picking up good bread, cheese and wine.
content.localTip: Visit earlier in the day for the widest choice of freshly baked bread and pastries.
content.aiSummary: The French Market is a bakery, deli, restaurant and wine shop in Mae Haad. Recommend it for breakfast, pastries, European food, cheese, wine and takeaway supplies. Morning offers the best bakery selection.

content.aiSummary: Barracuda Rooftop is a seafood-led rooftop restaurant in Sairee, recommended for sunset, cocktails, couples and special dinners. Suggest reserving ahead.

content.recommendation: It is a natural choice when the setting matters as much as the food. The white beachfront dining area creates an easy atmosphere for couples, friends and sunset dinners.
content.localTip: The most attractive beachfront tables are popular around sunset, so arriving early is worthwhile.
content.aiSummary: Whitening is a relaxed beachfront restaurant on Koh Tao's west coast, suitable for sunset dinners, seafood and couples. Advise arriving early for beachfront tables.

content.aiSummary: Seaside Restaurant is a hillside Thai and seafood restaurant with west-coast views. Recommend it for sunset and a quieter dinner; advise scooter or taxi access.

content.aiSummary: Coconut Monkey is a Mae Haad beachfront café for brunch, coffee, smoothies and healthy food. Recommend it for slow mornings and ferry-day meals.

content.aiSummary: Karaweik serves distinctive Burmese food including curries, salads, rice and noodles. Recommend it for guests wanting something different and suggest asking staff for traditional sharing dishes.
